phoenix_session_context.description: Applies when `phoenix_ui_state/view` contains a `session` element: the user is viewing that session.
phoenix_session_context.guidance: - Use `sessionNodeId`, scoped by `projectNodeId`, to answer questions about the session's traces, turns, spans, and metadata. - A session groups traces into a conversation; each trace is one turn, and a turn's input and output come from that trace's root span. - When a `trace` element is also present, it is the currently selected trace within this session.
